objectives: privileged functions are partitioned into separate physical domains.

objective.en: Privileged accounts are limited to authorised people, approved before creation, reviewed periodically and removed promptly when no longer needed.
objective.fr: Les comptes privilégiés sont réservés aux personnes autorisées, approuvés avant leur création, revus périodiquement et supprimés rapidement lorsqu'ils ne sont plus nécessaires.

procedures.step: Obtain the list of privileged accounts from each in-scope system and reconcile it with the documented account types and the list of authorised roles.
procedures.expected: Every privileged account maps to a documented account type and an authorised role.
procedures.exception: Any privileged account with no authorised owner or role is an exception.
procedures.sampling: Full population: privileged accounts are few enough to inspect all of them.

procedures.step: For a sample of privileged accounts created in the period, inspect the access request and check that the designated approver approved it before the account was created.
procedures.expected: Each sampled account has an approval dated on or before its creation.
procedures.exception: A missing approval, or one dated after creation, is an exception; one exception in the sample means the control did not operate effectively.
procedures.sampling: Random sample of 25 creations, or all if fewer, for a low tolerable deviation rate.

procedures.step: Inspect the evidence of the last two privileged access reviews: who reviewed, when, which accounts were confirmed or removed, and whether removals were carried out.
procedures.expected: Reviews occurred at the defined frequency and every removal decided was carried out.
procedures.exception: A missed review, or a removal decided but not done within the defined period, is an exception.
procedures.sampling: Both reviews of the period are inspected; no sampling.

procedures.step: Match HR departure records for the period against account deactivation dates and measure the delay for each departing person with privileged access.
procedures.expected: Privileged access of every departing person is removed within the defined time.
procedures.exception: Any privileged account still active after the defined time following departure is an exception.
procedures.sampling: All departures of people holding privileged access in the period.

procedures.step: Perform or observe a privileged action on a test system and confirm it appears in the security log with user, time and action.
procedures.expected: The privileged action is logged with enough detail to attribute it.
procedures.exception: An unlogged or unattributable privileged action is an exception.
procedures.sampling: Judgemental selection of one privileged function per in-scope platform.

label.fr: AUD-PAM-001-06 Entretien avec les gestionnaires de comptes

procedures.step: Interview the people who manage privileged accounts about how requests, reviews and removals are handled in practice, and compare with the documented procedure.
procedures.exception: A material difference between practice and procedure is noted for follow-up testing, not as an exception on its own.

objective.en: Vulnerabilities are found by regular scanning, analysed, and remediated within the defined response times, and security updates are installed on time.
objective.fr: Les vulnérabilités sont détectées par des analyses régulières, analysées et corrigées dans les délais définis, et les mises à jour de sécurité sont installées à temps.

label.fr: AUD-VULN-001-01 Couverture et fréquence des analyses

procedures.step: Compare the asset inventory with the scan target lists and scan schedules for the period.
procedures.expected: All in-scope systems are scanned at the defined frequency.
procedures.exception: An in-scope system missing from scans, or a missed scheduled scan, is an exception.
procedures.sampling: Full population of in-scope systems against scan configuration.

procedures.step: Inspect the triage records of scan results for the period to see that findings were analysed, false positives justified and risk ratings assigned.
procedures.expected: Each finding of high or critical severity has a recorded analysis.
procedures.exception: A high or critical finding with no analysis is an exception.
procedures.sampling: Random sample of 25 high or critical findings.

procedures.step: For a sample of remediated vulnerabilities, compute the time from detection to verified remediation and compare it with the defined response time for its severity.
procedures.expected: Each sampled vulnerability is remediated within its response time, or covered by an approved exception.
procedures.exception: A late remediation without an approved policy exception is an exception.
procedures.sampling: Random sample of 25, stratified by severity so that critical findings are all included.

label.fr: AUD-VULN-001-04 Installation des mises à jour de sécurité

procedures.step: For a sample of security updates released in the period, check installation dates on in-scope systems against the defined time period.
procedures.expected: Security-relevant updates are installed within the defined time period.
procedures.exception: An update installed late, or not installed without an approved exception, is an exception.

label.en: AUD-VULN-001-05 Testing of updates before installation
label.fr: AUD-VULN-001-05 Essai des mises à jour avant installation

procedures.step: Interview the patch management team about how updates are tested for effectiveness and side effects, and inspect one recent test record.
procedures.expected: Updates are tested before production installation, with a record.
procedures.exception: No test record for a recent update is an exception.
procedures.sampling: Judgemental selection of one recent update.

note: NIST SP 800-53A Rev. 5 objectives and methods (public domain, NIST) and CRGO's illustrative work programmes (CC BY-NC 4.0). The work programmes are illustrative, not a validated audit methodology.
